description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Dashboard/GetListingSummary. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Returns an aggregate summary of published products, recent products and average price for the current channel. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Domain: listings. Entity: listing_summary. Operation: aggregate. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use it for dashboard views or aggregate metrics for the selected channel. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Does not use concrete listing ids. Output: Returns listing counters and aggregates. Search terms: dashboard getlistingsummary. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

name: hgr_get_dashboard_getlistingsummary
title: Get Dashboard Getlistingsummary
